name: Pilot
summary: A personal browser-automation agent. You describe a goal, and it navigates sites in your own logged-in browser, extracts what matters and compiles the result.
highlights: Turns live pages into compact, stable DOM summaries the agent targets by ref ID, with a vision fallback for canvas pages
Records the first successful run as a recipe that replays deterministically with zero model calls
Pauses risky actions for approval and never handles passwords; supports local LLMs via Ollama

name: EventScout
summary: Finds local events and jobs in your city from public, structured sources and puts them on one searchable page, with no API keys needed.
highlights: Aggregates ten event sites plus six job APIs, built on schema.org JSON-LD and open APIs only
Filters by category, date, price, age and distance from an address, shown as a list or a map
Client-side résumé matching for jobs; optional account sync; ships as an Electron app

name: LeagueGraph
summary: A personal League of Legends analytics dashboard that pulls your full match history from the Riot API and answers questions the official client can't.
highlights: Item win rates vs. your baseline, answering which items actually help you win
Win % when ahead or behind your lane opponent in gold, CS and XP at 10, 15, 20 and 25 minutes
Incremental sync and caching in SQLite, so reopening is instant

name: AccountFinder
summary: An OSINT correlation tool. From one username, URL or email it finds public accounts across platforms and cross-checks which ones really belong to the same person.
highlights: Pipeline: handle permutation → presence detection → profile extraction → correlation
Ranks matches by confidence with reasons (shared avatar hash, rel=me links, matching names)
Flags likely false matches and weak leads instead of hiding them

name: Cover Letter Tailor
summary: Offline cover-letter drafting. Give it your résumé and a job posting, and it drafts a tailored letter, marks the parts only you can write and gives you a checklist.
highlights: No API key, account or cloud: your résumé never leaves your machine
Parses PDF and DOCX résumés and exports to DOCX
Designed to sound like you, not like AI

name: SacredSafe
summary: A local-first, encrypted password manager. Everything stays on your machine with no accounts, sync or telemetry.
highlights: AES-256-GCM vault encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation (310k iterations)
Per-user encrypted vaults with autosave
Cryptographically random password and username generators

name: Protect Your Plot
summary: A squad-command lane-defense autobattler: hire peasants to defend your plot against beasts, soldiers and plague.
highlights: Built in Godot 4 with GDScript
Squad-command unit control on top of lane-defense waves

name: LinkWatch
summary: A desktop app that scrapes a set of URLs on a schedule, tracks which links are new and shows the results on a daily, weekly or monthly timeline.
highlights: Per-source schedules with active hours and keyword title filters
Test runs preview results without touching saved history

name: This site
summary: Static portfolio and daily log generated from Markdown by a small Node build script, deployed on GitHub Pages and Vercel.

name: Restaurant Location Finder
summary: Streamlit app that maps nearby restaurants with location search and cuisine filters, using OpenStreetMap data.

name: News App
summary: Tkinter desktop reader for the News API with search and article filtering.

name: TreeNodes
summary: A game with animals categorized in a tree structure, built around tree traversal.

name: ClueGame
summary: Java implementation of Clue with a Swing GUI, AI players and JUnit tests (with Levi Sprung).
